Digits.canonical-tail: (w : Digit) (w₁ : Word) → Canonical (w ∷ w₁) → Canonical w₁
Digits.dsucΣ:
(w : Digit) →
Σ-syntax (Digit × Bool)
(λ w₁ → suc (toℕ w) ≡ toℕ (fst w₁) + carryVal (snd w₁) · b)
Digits.value-sucw-step:
(w : Digit) (w₁ : Word) →
value (sucw w₁) ≡ suc (value w₁) →
(r : Digit × Bool) →
suc (toℕ w) ≡ toℕ (fst r) + carryVal (snd r) · b →
value (sucwAux r w₁) ≡ suc (value (w ∷ w₁))
Digits.sucw-nonempty:
(w : Word) →
Σ-syntax Digit (λ w₁ → Σ-syntax Word (λ r → sucw w ≡ w₁ ∷ r))
Digits.canonical-cons:
(w : Digit) (w₁ : Word) →
Σ-syntax Digit (λ r → Σ-syntax Word (λ v → w₁ ≡ r ∷ v)) →
Canonical w₁ → Canonical (w ∷ w₁)
Digits.canonical-sucw-step:
(w : Digit) (w₁ : Word) →
(Canonical w₁ → Canonical (sucw w₁)) →
Canonical (w ∷ w₁) →
(r : Digit × Bool) →
suc (toℕ w) ≡ toℕ (fst r) + carryVal (snd r) · b →
Canonical (sucwAux r w₁)
Digits.digit-split:
(w w₁ : Digit) (r v : ℕ) →
toℕ w + b · r ≡ toℕ w₁ + b · v → (toℕ w ≡ toℕ w₁) × (r ≡ v)
Digits.canonical-pos:
(w : Digit) (w₁ : Word) →
Canonical (w ∷ w₁) → Σ-syntax ℕ (λ r → value (w ∷ w₁) ≡ suc r)
Digits.value-inj:
(w w₁ : Word) →
Canonical w → Canonical w₁ → value w ≡ value w₁ → w ≡ w₁
